scope: 24 original OLMo3 main-table runs and six available ablation runs. No new evaluations were run for this export.
run_id_definition: Original experiment-directory basename, or the original supplied CSV run number. Run numbers are labels, not evidence of different RNG seeds.
precision: Metric-file values are retained at parsed floating-point precision. The signed-BM25 source was supplied at two decimal places. No values were reconstructed from means or standard deviations.

aggregation.Validation_source: arithmetic mean of BBH, MBPP_plus, MATH, MMLU_Pro
aggregation.Additional: arithmetic mean of ZebraLogic, LCB_v5, OlympiadBench, GPQA_D
aggregation.All: arithmetic mean of the eight benchmark scores
aggregation.standard_deviation: sample standard deviation across three runs (ddof=1); aggregate metrics are calculated within each run first
aggregation.BBH: micro average over 18 subtasks and 4,365 questions

notes: All mean and sample-standard-deviation summaries match the corresponding paper table at two decimal places for every included method.
Some per-benchmark summaries differ in the last decimal place when calculated from full-precision metrics. Values are not adjusted to match the table; differences are listed below.

For Random, full-precision GPQA mean is 33.7752525253; averaging per-run scores first rounded to two decimals gives 33.7733333333. The MBPP+ standard-deviation difference is likewise explained by per-run rounding.
IF (GraSS) GPQA yields 34.36 +/- 0.43, compared with the paper's 34.35 +/- 0.41; rounding each run to two decimals does not resolve this difference.
Base is not included: the starting checkpoint is not a three-run continual-training condition.

Source paths are relative archive references. A ** segment omits deployment-specific model-path directories; filename plus SHA256 identifies the source metric file. Original metric JSON files and model responses are not bundled here.

extraction.selection: Explicit protocol-matched metric files; separate greedy evaluations are not combined via filename-order overwrites.

rows.note: Assembled from dispersed files whose recorded model is the same olmo_uniform_safe checkpoint-500; stochastic benchmarks use their declared repeated-sampling files.
Uses eval_output_olmes_0424 explicitly, excluding the separate greedy evaluation.
